blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: A hash table turns a key into an array index with a hash function, so you can jump straight to where an item belongs instead of searching for it.

blocks.title: Using a table
items: Hash the key to a number
Take it modulo the table size
Store or look up in that slot

blocks.title: A string hash
Add to a chain
A good hash function
items: Same key always gives the same result

blocks.body: Collisions cannot be avoided. Compare strings with `strcmp`, never `==`, and free keys you copied.
